query: I have a 67-year-old female patient. Among female Medicare patients aged 62–72 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of syncope (ICD-9 780.2 or ICD-10 R55), what is the total number of index admissions in this cohort?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_index_admissions
FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions a
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p
  ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd d
  ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 62 AND 72
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND UPPER(a.admission_location) LIKE '%EMERGENCY%'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND (
    (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code = '7802')
    OR
    (d.icd_version = 10 AND d.icd_code = 'R55')
  );
